name: Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora - From the Ashes Edition
summary:
Includes the main game, From the Ashes expansion and bonus content.

Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora is an action-adventure game set in the Western Frontier. Play a Na’vi, abducted and trained by the RDA to serve their purpose. Fifteen years later, you are free but find yourself a stranger in your birthplace, engaged in a fight for freedom against the RDA.

- Experience the epic and unpredictable Western Frontier in an open world adventure.
- Become a Na'vi: customize your character, craft gear, and upgrade skills and weapons to fit your playstyle.
- Bond with your own banshee to travel or give you an edge in aerial combat.
- Master multiple combat styles, embracing traditional Na’vi or destructive human weapons.
- Play the full story campaign in single-player or with a friend online in two-player co-op.

In the From the Ashes expansion, face new enemies as So’lek in a ravaged Western Frontier with revamped combat, improved banshee mechanics, and epic boss fights against the RDA and the Ash clan.

- Embark on a journey of vengeance as So'lek, a Na'vi warrior haunted by his past.
- Experience this journey designed for third-person gameplay, which remains playable in first person at your choice.
- Enjoy a streamlined progression system, enhanced combat, and stealth gameplay, including improved ikran mechanics and brutal takedown finishers.
- Face the Ash clan in improved combat and epic boss fights.
- Navigate an unrecognizable world ravaged by destruction and flames.
